title: Mitsubishi Motors Ukraine
description: itsubishi-motors.com.ua Mitsubishi Motors Ukraine is the official importer and distributor of Mitsubishi Motors vehicles in Ukraine, managing sales, service and parts through over 20 authorized dealers nationwide. Its model range includes the Outlander and Outlander PHEV crossover, Eclipse Cross, ASX and the legendary L200 pickup truck. As part of the Renault-Nissan-Mitsubishi Alliance, it benefits from global R&D, shared platforms and a 5-year warranty. The Ukrainian automotive market recovered to around 60,000 new car sales in 2025, with Mitsubishi holding a 3 to 5 percent share led by Outlander and L200. Services span new and certified pre-owned sales, original parts, financing through partner banks and full after-sales support. Strategic initiatives include expanding the PHEV hybrid lineup and preparing for fully electric model launches.
